CustomField.description: Position-restricted skills: empty = every staff member can see and use this skill. Filled = only staff whose Contact.Current_Position__c is one of these values can see it (Library, @ list, Required picker) or receive it (router, @ mention, load_skill/search_skills, subagents). Shares the TCCFO_Positions global value set with Contact.Current_Position__c, so renamed/added positions appear in both (rename with "Replace", not an API-name edit). Read by the LiteLLM proxy within 10 minutes. A restricted skill must be a plain text skill (validation rule Restricted_Skill_Must_Be_Plain_Text) and no other firm skill may require it (Apex in ChatbotInstructionTrigger + validation rules).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Leave empty for everyone. Pick positions to limit who can see and use this skill.
CustomField.label: Restricted to Positions
